yt.description:
Positions of a 3x3x3 puzzle cube: 8!·3^7·12!·2^11/2, computed. God's number (20) was proven in 2010.
Narration is AI-generated.

scenes.narration: A puzzle cube that fits in your hand can be scrambled in more ways than you'd believe.
Eight corners and twelve edges, each with positions and twists. Multiply it all.

scenes.text: Any of them: 20 moves or less
scenes.narration: Yet every single one can be solved in twenty moves or fewer. Proven in twenty ten.
